title: Semantic recall audit harness: gold-pair reference sets, offline metrics, and drift alarms
creator: Priya Patel
description: Build a production-grade evaluation harness to measure embedding accuracy and reranking quality across models and variants. The system will maintain curated reference pairs (gold-pair sets) across customer-relevant domains, run deterministic offline metrics (NDCG, MRR, Precision@K, MAP), and surface drift/regression signals with actionable alerts. The harness should be inexpensive to run nightly, support per-model and per-deployment baselines, and provide breakdowns by query type, sequence length, and latency bucket.
acceptance_criteria: Gold-pair repository with at least 5 domain-specific datasets and provenance metadata for each entry
Nightly offline job that computes NDCG@10, MRR, Precision@1/5/10 and stores results in BigQuery/GCS
Drift detector that triggers alerts when embedding distribution KS-stat > 0.08 or NDCG drop > 3% relative to baseline
Dashboard in Grafana and /embed-alerts Slack integration with run summaries and top failing prompts
Run artifacts (per-run diffs, sample failed queries, HTML report) persisted and linked to ticketing/PRs
Baseline comparison enables pinned model version and automatic canary comparison for new model uploads
design_notes: Gold-pair format: CSV with columns [id, query, positive_ids, negative_ids, domain, created_by, created_at, tags]
Offline metrics: use rerank simulation where we compute similarity matrix between query embedding and candidate embeddings; compute true labels using positive_ids and derive ranking metrics
Drift signals: combine distributional tests (KS over pairwise cosine distances), centroid shift, and changes in top-k overlap across baseline and current
Cost controls: sample 10k queries per domain per night, with configurable sampling rate per model to limit GPU/compute spend
Telemetry hooks: emit token/compute cost estimates per run and record median/95th latency by model variant and batch size
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (2 wks): schema and storage for gold-pairs (GCS), ingestion CLI, and small seed datasets from search/QA/product teams
Phase 2 (2 wks): offline runner that computes similarity matrices, ranking metrics, and stores run-level metadata in BigQuery
Phase 3 (1 wk): drift detection service and alert rules (KS, NDCG deltas), Slack and PagerDuty hooks
Phase 4 (1 wk): Grafana dashboards and per-model time-series, sample repro artifacts, and GitHub action to attach reports to PRs
Phase 5 (ongoing): expand domains, support synthetic perturbation suite, and add automated rollback runbook tied to Dedicated/private deployments
metrics: Nightly run compute cost (USD) and run duration
Percentage of runs that triggered alerts
rollout_plan: Start with internal domains (search docs, support KB, snippet rerank) and a dry-run mode that emails results to eng+pm
Enable Slack alerts for engr leads after 2 successful dry-runs
Expose per-customer goldset tagging for enterprise pilots (opt-in)
When stable, gate model promotion pipelines so new model uploads must show no negative regression vs pinned baseline for key domains
risks: Goldset maintenance burden — need owners and review cadence
False positives from distributional tests on small sample sizes
Cost of nightly runs if sampling not tuned
Private/VPC customers require access controls and cannot share gold-pair data — need per-tenant isolation
